Good Questions

❓ Thanksgiving FAQ

Straight answers, using only the facts on this page.

🔎 Search the FAQ

How much caffeine is in XS™ Energy?
The 12 oz XS™ family carries 114 mg caffeine per can, with no sugar — host fuel that lasts the whole cooking day.
What makes Dish Drops™ the cleanup MVP?
It's ultraconcentrated — one drop cleans a lot — and it cuts through a sinkful of greasy, dirty dishes. The patented formula includes aloe vera + shiso extracts, and it's EPA Safer Choice recognized.
What's special about the Artistry Light Up Lip?
A built-in LED light + mirror in the cap and 10-hour wear — and at $28.25, one of the prices verified on amway.com for this page (November 2026).
Why eSpring™ for Thanksgiving cooking?
The new eSpring™ pairs an e3 Carbon Filter — reducing 170+ contaminants, including lead, mercury, microplastics and PFOA/PFOS — with UV-C LEDs that destroy up to 99.9999% of bacteria, 99.99% of viruses and 99.9% of cysts. It's NSF certified to Standards 42, 53, 55 and 401, carries the WQA Gold Seal, and keeps beneficial minerals like calcium, magnesium, potassium and zinc — so cooking water, coffee and the dinner pitcher all taste better.
How do I order everything on this page?
Through Clark Essential Solutions — tap any gold button or scan the QR card in the order section below. Ordering through the shop link is what connects your order to the Clarks.
